## Compute Next Occurrence

A read-only answer to "when is this plan next due?" for a caller that wants it without reading the plan's own computed fields: a command-driven action or an AI tool call. It wraps the plan's `planNext`, which calls `nextOccurrence` in `utils/recurrence.ts`, so the answer is the same one the Maintenance Plan card, the calendar and the Generate PM Work Orders command use.

The result carries the next `dueDate` (a local calendar day) and/or `dueMeter`, which half decided it (`calendar`, `meter` or `none`), the days or meter units remaining, whether it is due now, and the `generateOn` date the generator will raise the Work Order. `asOf` evaluates the plan at another instant, so "was this due last Tuesday" needs no wall clock.

### Non-goals

Never writes: raising the Work Order is **Generate PM Work Orders**.
